text_block_list.text:
While training on the track with Symboli 
Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, so this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The Chairwoman suddenly came to the 
student council room. Said it was an 
emergency or something, so I listened, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Looks like a total pain in the neck. You 
handle the rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see how it is. I'll take over for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Excuse me for a moment. I'm 
going to hear what Brian has to say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—The matter Brian brought to us turned out 
to be far more difficult than imagined.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have confirmed that without my initial 
judgment as Student Council President, 
many matters struggle to move forward 
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So here's my request— I'd like a little 
time to resolve this matter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Normally, this would take an entire day, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I focus on handling only the parts that 
require my judgment, I don't think it'll 
take long before I can return.
choice_data_list: You should focus on it for a whole day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. I've made you worry. 
You're quick to understand, which helps a 
lot."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Taking you up on your offer, I shall 
devote myself today to seeing this matter 
thoroughly resolved.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ――Well then, I'm heading out.

True to her word, Symboli Rudolf cleared 
Chairwoman Akikawa's matter within a 
single day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll clean this up and be right 
back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you it wouldn't take long? 
Brian and the others can take over from 
here for now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I plan to address it once today's training 
is over. There's no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we continue?

Seeing how swiftly and skillfully she 
delivered on her word, I couldn't help but 
be impressed.
